jobs.title: Product Owner Cloud
jobs.description:
Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles!

As Product Owner for our Cloud solutions, you are responsible for driving the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of our products. You work closely with a full team—both functional and development—so affinity with both is important. You organize and prioritize the team’s work through a well-managed backlog and sprint board, ensuring delivery of maximum value to our customers. 
 
❗This is a Full time permanent position

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Owner – Platform (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Rolle

Vom Kundenportal bis zur Rückgabe: Du prägst die Roadmap unserer Plattform.
Unsere Plattform ist das Herzstück von Everphone. Über sie bestellen Geschäftskunden Smartphones, Tablets und Laptops für ihre Mitarbeitenden, rollen sie aus und geben sie am Ende zurück. Als (Senior) Product Owner (w/m/d) übernimmst du einen Bereich dieser Plattform und gestaltest gemeinsam mit deiner Squad aus Engineers die nächsten Features. Du sprichst mit Kunden sowie mit Operations, Customer Success und Sales. So findest du heraus, wo es wirklich hakt, und machst daraus Lösungen, die im Alltag funktionieren. AI ist dabei dein tägliches Werkzeug: Du analysierst, baust Prototypen und automatisierst damit, und du prägst mit, wie wir als Team mit AI arbeiten. Wenn du gern tief in komplexe Prozesse einsteigst und Dinge vorantreibst, ist diese Rolle für dich gemacht.


Deine Aufgaben

Produktbereich verantworten

  • Strategie und Roadmap: Du entwickelst Strategie und Roadmap deines Produktbereichs und verantwortest das Backlog.
  • Priorisierung: Du arbeitest mit Operations & Logistics, Customer Success und Sales und machst aus ihren konkurrierenden Anforderungen klare Prioritäten.
  • Projekte: Du steuerst mehrere Vorhaben parallel, etwa neue Nutzerrollen mit Freigabeprozessen oder die Anbindung von Partnerportalen.
  • Neue Servicemodelle: Gemeinsam mit Sales und unseren Kunden bewertest du Ideen für neue Servicemodelle, bevor sie in die Umsetzung gehen.

Kunden und Prozesse

  • Gerätelebenszyklus: Du verstehst die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und ihrer Mitarbeitenden entlang des gesamten Gerätelebenszyklus, von Bestellung und Rollout bis zu Support, Reparatur und Rückgabe. Daraus leitest du klare, gut geschnittene Anforderungen ab.
  • Adoption: Du treibst die Adoption voran und holst regelmäßig Nutzerfeedback ein.
  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Du validierst Ideen früh und automatisierst manuelle Schritte in unseren Serviceprozessen.

AI und KPIs

  • AI in der Produktarbeit: Du nutzt AI für die Analyse von Kundenfeedback und Daten und für Produktartefakte.
  • Prototypen: Du baust Prototypen selbst, damit Ideen schneller validiert werden.
  • KPIs: Du definierst und verfolgst Produkt-KPIs und stellst sicher, dass dein Produktbereich messbar zu den Zielen von Everphone beiträgt.


Was Everphone dir bietet

KI ist bei uns Arbeitsalltag

  • KI-Tools ab Tag eins: Moderne KI-Tools stehen allen Rollen zur Verfügung, nicht nur dem Tech-Team
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du darfst Prozesse hinterfragen und mit KI neu bauen. Eigene Automatisierungen und Tools sind ausdrücklich erwünscht
  • Voneinander lernen: Kolleg:innen teilen offen, wie sie ihre Arbeit mit KI neu aufgebaut haben, und du lernst direkt aus der Praxis

Zeit & Flexibilität

  • Hybrides Arbeiten & Workation: Eine Mischung aus Office und Homeoffice, dazu bis zu 4 Wochen pro Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland
  • Urlaub: 30 Tage pro Jahr
  • Dein Setup: Laptop und Smartphone deiner Wahl. Wir sind schließlich Device-as-a-Service

Finanzen & Gesundheit

  • Finanzielle Extras: Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, bis zu 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat und 348 € ÖPNV-Zuschuss pro Jahr
  • Essenszuschuss: Wir bezuschussen dein Mittagessen, einfach Beleg per App hochladen
  • Gesundheit: Bezuschusste Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft und kostenfreie, vertrauliche mentale Unterstützung über Voiio

Gemeinschaft

  • Im Office: Wöchentliche bezahlte Company Lunches und Frühstücks-Events, frisches Obst, Snacks und Kaffeespezialitäten. Und dein Hund ist auch willkommen
  • Sprachen: Vollständig finanzierte Deutsch- und Englischkurse, damit sich im internationalen Team alle gut verstehen
  • Community: Sommer- und Winterfest sowie Employee Resource Groups, in denen du dich vernetzen und einbringen kannst


Das bringst du mit

Must-haves

  • Produkterfahrung: Du hast 3 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager für digitale Produkte, idealerweise für eine B2B-Plattform oder ein SaaS-Produkt. Du hast einen Produktbereich end-to-end verantwortet und kannst deine Erfolge mit Zahlen belegen.
  • AI-first: AI gehört fest zu deinem Arbeitsalltag. Du hast damit selbst Dinge gebaut, zum Beispiel per Vibe Coding entwickelte Tools, Prototypen, Analysen oder Skripte. Du weißt, wo AI hilft und wo nicht, und bringst dein Team damit weiter.
  • Agile Produktentwicklung: Du hast Erfahrung in agiler Produktentwicklung und übersetzt komplexe, wenig standardisierte Prozesse in einfache, nutzerfreundliche Lösungen.
  • Stakeholder und Change: Du überzeugst Führungskräfte, Kund:innen und Fachbereiche, verhandelst Trade-offs und setzt Veränderungen bereichsübergreifend durch.
  • Technisches Verständnis: Du musst nicht selbst programmieren, verstehst aber den Softwareentwicklungsprozess. Du ordnest Aussagen von Entwickler:innen zu Deployments oder Problemen ein und mergst bei Bedarf selbst Code in GitHub.
  • Problemlösung: Du durchdringst komplexe Sachverhalte schnell, deckst mit kritischen Fragen die eigentlichen Probleme auf und findest kreative Lösungen.
  • Umsetzungsstärke: Du packst selbst an und bringst Engineers und Stakeholder unaufgeregt, aber direkt nach vorn.
  • Sprachen: Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch mindestens auf C1-Niveau 
Nice-to-haves
  • Branchenerfahrung: Du kennst Online-Bestellprozesse in Verbindung mit physischer Logistik, zum Beispiel aus E-Commerce.


Not a perfect match? Apply anyway! Wenn dich die Rolle begeistert, freuen wir uns sehr auf deine Bewerbung – auch wenn du nicht alles erfüllst. Schau nur, ob die wichtigsten Punkte wie Sprachkenntnisse passen.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager – Managed Detection and Incident Response (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 190 FTEs and continue to grow internationally having secured our Series C funding of €60 Million!

We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds — all united by a shared mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.

At Eye, you'll work on projects with an international footprint, solving real-world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients.

About this role

As our client base continues to grow rapidly across Europe, this role will play a key strategic part in scaling our Managed Detection and Response (MDR), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), and Incident Response (IR) capabilities.

You'll take full ownership of the product strategy and roadmap for this space. Collaborating with our engineers, product designers, security operations, product marketing, and cross-functional leadership, you will ensure that our platform evolves with our customers' needs and delivers maximum impact at scale.

This is a senior individual contributor and thought leadership role designed for someone who thrives on autonomy, discovery, and leading cross-functional product development in a fast-growing environment. You'll be the strategic voice shaping our product direction, mentoring product managers, and influencing broader company strategy.

What you will do

  • Own and communicate the long-term product vision and strategy for MDR, EDR, and IR. Define strategic priorities, influence company OKRs, and drive cross-functional alignment around product direction.

  • Define and own the product roadmap for MDR, EDR, and IR, ensuring alignment with company vision, market opportunity, and customer needs.

  • Drive discovery practices to deeply understand customer needs, problems, and pain points.

  • Lead and mentor product managers and junior team members. Work closely with Engineering, Product Design, Security Operations, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales to deliver successful outcomes and build high-performing teams.

  • Partner with Product Marketing to define comprehensive go-to-market strategies, product launches, and market positioning that drive competitive advantage.

  • Manage external relationships and partnerships, especially with EDR vendors and MDR technology providers, ensuring alignment with our MSP and partner strategy.

  • Stay at the forefront of cybersecurity trends, emerging technologies, and industry best practices.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our internal processes, tooling, and product culture. Champion agile methodologies, data-driven execution, and continuous experimentation.

What you will need

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 4 years in senior or staff-level roles owning end-to-end delivery of software products in B2B SaaS or similar environments.

  • Deep cybersecurity domain expertise.

  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex software products in fast-paced environments using product discovery, data-driven decision making, and agile methodologies.

  • Strong business acumen: understanding of go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, and how product drives revenue and customer success.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex strategies clearly to technical, commercial, and executive audiences.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with comfort in ambiguity and the ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information.

  • Fluent English

Nice-to-have

  • Startup or scale-up background at a high-growth company.

  • Experience building or scaling product management teams and processes.

  • Exposure to OKR-driven product development and metrics-focused product management.

  • Experience working with MSP or partner-led go-to-market models.

  • Track record of navigating successful product pivots or strategic repositioning.

What we offer

  • A meaningful mission: protect organizations across Europe from real-world cyber threats.

  • Work with top-tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds.

  • Full strategic ownership of a mission-critical product area in a high-growth cybersecurity scale-up.

  • Mentorship and growth: lead and develop the next generation of product managers; grow into broader strategy and leadership roles.

  • Weekly lunches (NL) and Thursday socials to stay connected.

  • A generous time-off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including equity participation.

Are you up for it?

jobs.title: Staff / Senior Product Manager, Payments
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the Role

As a Senior / Staff Product Manager, you will play a defining role in shaping the future of global money movement, embedded commerce, and unified payment acceptance at Airwallex. Operating at the intersection of core clearing/settlement infrastructure, merchant-facing experiences, and developer-first toolkits, you will own the end-to-end product lifecycle—from long-term strategy and architectural design to global roadmap execution.

In this role, you will bridge our online payments-for-platforms suite (enabling marketplaces and SaaS platforms to collect, route, and embed payments) with next-generation in-person commerce (smart POS, SoftPOS, hardware/software integrations, and loyalty engines). You will lead cross-functional teams to modernise omnichannel workflows, scale coverage across international markets, and deploy AI-native capabilities that remove operational friction for global merchants.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the vision, roadmap, and delivery plans for Airwallex’s platform payments and in-person commerce solutions, expanding our reach across key verticals, marketplaces, and global geographies.

  • Architect seamless integrations connecting POS terminal workflows and embedded platform checkouts directly to core clearing, ledgering, and multi-currency settlement engines—optimising for processing speed, fee netting, and dynamic routing.

  • Build developer-first APIs, unified commerce SDKs, and intuitive terminal management systems (TMS) that drastically reduce integration overhead for marketplaces, platforms, and third-party software vendors.

  • Pioneer AI workflows and autonomous agents across merchant onboarding, automated terminal setup, dispute/risk management, transaction reconciliation, and proactive loyalty/reward engine optimisations.

  • Expand capabilities around alternative payment methods (APMs), card acquiring, and integrated loyalty redemption loops to help platforms monetize payments and retain underlying sellers.

  • Ensure high-availability infrastructure (including offline POS processing resilience) while delivering tooling to help merchants satisfy regulatory mandates (PCI-DSS, EMV, PSD3/local frameworks) and manage platform risk.

  • Partner closely with Engineering, Hardware/Firmware, Commercial, Legal/Compliance, and Operations teams to build scalable feedback loops and launch high-impact products from concept to global scale.

Who You Are

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of product management experience building high-scale, mission-critical platform products in fintech, payments, or commerce infrastructure (Staff-level scope).

  • Hands-on domain expertise in card acquiring, embedded finance/platform payment models (marketplaces, payfac-like setups), or card-present ecosystems (POS/SoftPOS, EMV/NFC standards, terminal management).

  • Proven ability to engage deeply with engineering on complex architectural discussions covering API design, distributed ledgers, high-throughput transaction processing, and hardware/software interfaces.

  • Exceptional analytical rigor with a track record of structuring complex ecosystem workflows, leveraging data to drive strategic trade-offs, and solving ambiguous problems.

  • High agency, persistence, and an entrepreneurial bias for action—capable of executing fast and driving complex initiatives to completion in a high-growth environment.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; proven success influencing cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders across diverse international regions.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher with strong academic performance, preferably with coursework in Computer Science, Engineering, or quantitative disciplines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience designing or scaling developer-first payment APIs, unified commerce SDKs, or multi-sided platform architectures.

  • Hands-on exposure to deploying Generative AI, agentic workflows, or automated intelligence in fintech operations, transaction reconciliation, or onboarding.

  • Working familiarity with international card networks, alternative payment methods (APMs), cross-border settlement rails, and regional regulatory frameworks (UK/EU, APAC, or Americas).

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Wanna join the adventure?

At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.

We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast.

This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.

You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority.


About this role:
Understand what is possible, and turn it into requirements
  • Spend the bulk of your time with engineering: understanding architectures, constraints, and dependencies well enough to judge what is realistically doable in a given timeframe.
  • Translate strategic direction into clear requirements and use cases that engineering can act on directly, and follow them down to the Jira tickets.
  • Surface and shape the good ideas that come from engineering — many of the best ones do — and connect them to a product rationale.
  • Define success criteria for each capability, and verify they are actually met through implementation and delivery.
  • Maintain an accurate, shared view of Loft's product capabilities, what is in development, and where the gaps are.

    • Bring the outside in

    • Run customer discovery interviews alongside business development, and debrief missions to see how Loft's capabilities are actually used in operations.
    • Engage directly with the partners building on our platform, including the onboard AI application ecosystem, to understand their needs and constraints.
    • Track market trends and competitive moves closely enough to know where our offering stands.

      • Decide and prioritize

      • Own the roadmap for your perimeter, reconciling customer needs, engineering reality, and Loft's strategy into a single coherent plan.

OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Buying and selling a car should feel like one seamless motion for a dealer, not two separate systems. Right now it's the opposite: a dealer buys through us, then has to manage collection, payment and resale largely on their own, stitching together workflows across multiple platforms and channels, much of it manual.

For a dealer, speed is money. Every extra day a car sits before it's collected, priced, and paid for is a day of depreciation, tied-up capital, and a missed chance to buy the next one.If we can get a dealer from 'I've bought this car' to 'it's ready and paid for' faster through transport and collections, quicker final pricing, and Wallet, we make them more profitable. A dealer who's more profitable because of Carwow has little reason to go elsewhere: they'll lean on us more, and churn less.

This role owns that last-mile agenda: getting cars collected quickly, resolving final price without friction, and making Wallet work the way dealers expect it to. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Dealers are already asking for smarter scheduling, less manual chasing, and tools that reduce the overhead of running a business. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. If you want to own an operational product area end to end, work with some of the most sophisticated buyers in UK retail, and build things that have a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Own the product direction for Carwow's dealer-facing product, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery work with dealers, interviews, on-site visits, data analysis to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value

    • Identify and test opportunities to bring AI into dealer workflows: smarter recommendations, vehicle pricing, performance insights that actually change behaviour

    • Collaborate with Tech Lead, Designer, and Engineers to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness prioritising work that drives engagement, retention, and revenue, not just activity

  • Partner Engagement & Insight:

    • Build relationships with key dealer partners and use those relationships to validate product direction before we build

    • Work with Account Management and Sales to understand what's driving churn, what's blocking adoption, and what would make carwow stickier

    • Translate qualitative partner feedback into structured product insight; don't just collect opinions, turn them into decisions

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, commercial, and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Support the commercial team on partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 1.5+ years of product management experience in a B2B or SaaS environment, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics

  • Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox

jobs.description:
Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet?

We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.

Our global team of 500 drives things forward collaboratively, takes personal responsibility, values constructive critical thinking, and is dedicated to serving our customers and planet.

The Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product team and own the internal, backend-heavy products behind our operations.

Every item rebuy sells has been through our hands. Before a pre-owned book, DVD, or game reaches a customer, it has been bought in, received, identified, tested, graded, stored, picked, packed, and shipped. The systems that run this flow are the focus of this team, and the users are the hundreds of colleagues in our operations teams.


You will own the tools and services behind inbound processing, grading and quality control, fulfillment, and returns. Your users are warehouse operators, graders, pickers, and operations leads. Your customers are, in the end, every rebuy buyer and seller who relies on the condition and delivery promise we make.

For this role we need someone who is genuinely detail-oriented, who reads the data before forming an opinion, who understands systems and data flows end-to-end, and who can translate operational reality into precise requirements and measurable outcomes.

As a Product Manager you work hand in hand with operations leadership, team leads, engineering, and data to deliver measurable efficiency and quality improvements. You will spend time on the floor with the people who use your products, translate their goals and constraints into a roadmap you own, build the business case with unit economics together with operations and finance, and negotiate scope and timing with engineering. Improvements are co-created with the people who run the operation, not handed to them.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive domain product roadmap: Translate ops strategy (throughput, unit cost, quality, lead time) into a 6–12 month roadmap with the Strategy Manager and Ops Product Lead. Make and document trade-off decisions with ops leaders

  • Understand operational reality: Spend time at the warehouse mapping processes and data flows end-to-end to uncover system gaps and unmet needs early

  • Drive data-backed decisions: Analyze KPIs, pull data, avoid measurement traps, and connect feature changes to unit economics improvements

  • Write precise requirements: Specify business rules, edge cases, data models, state transitions, integrations, and failure modes for engineering

  • Ship iteratively without disruption: Sequence releases safely using pilots, feature flags, parallel runs, change management, and pre-defined metrics

  • Collaborate across teams: Engage in technical discussions and manage scope, time, and urgency trade-offs with tech and ops leads

  • Build stakeholder buy-in: Align ops, CS, tech, finance, and leadership on shared metrics via clear written communication


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on backend, internal, workflow, or operational products (for example warehouse, logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, order management, inventory, marketplace operations, fintech back-office, or similar)

  • Hands-on data skills: you can work fluently in an analytics environment, build your own analyses, define metrics rigorously, and spot when a number is misleading

  • Strong attention to detail: experience writing precise specifications covering business rules, edge cases, data models, and failure modes, and catching problems before they reach production

  • Systems thinking: you can map a multi-step operational process and the data flowing through it, identify bottlenecks and inconsistencies, and reason about second-order effects of a change

  • Experience collaborating with engineering on technical decisions, including integrations and data migrations, and negotiating scope and time-to-market trade-offs

  • Clear, structured communication skills, written and verbal, with the ability to build buy-in with operations team leads, engineering, and product leadership

  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to accelerate daily work such as analysis, writing, and prototyping

  • Fluency in English and German

Location:

  • Berlin

  • Hybrid model (Must be willing to have regular presence at our operations sites located in Rudow)


Purpose, a great company culture and incredible benefits - what to expect at rebuy:

  • Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time.

  • Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome.

  • Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed.

  • Take care of your work-life balance with 30 vacation days.

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position:

Sonar is looking for an Inside Sales Executive to join a Major Accounts pod and support two Major Account Managers in covering a portfolio of key accounts end to end. You will help the pod reach complete coverage of each account by prospecting into entities that are not yet customers and supporting entities that already run Sonar instances. You will own the full sales cycle on the opportunities you source: qualification, proof of concept, business case, negotiation with procurement and close.


On a daily basis, you will

  • Partner with two Major Account Managers in a pod model to build and execute account plans that give full coverage of key accounts and their business units

  • Support Marketing with account-based, customer-focused campaigns, and work with SDRs, Customer Success and Sales Operations to hand over smoothly after the sale

  • Share customer and competitive insights, and proactively build, grow and share sales team best practices

jobs.description:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

Orbem’s AI-powered MRI systems run on edge infrastructure deployed directly at customer sites, such as hatcheries and food processing plants. As an Expert Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the reliability, availability, and performance of this growing global fleet.

You are the team’s deepest technical authority on the on-premise platform, setting architecture and standards through hands-on expertise. You will own the hardware, network, operating system, and Kubernetes layers that power teams like Data, Machine Learning, and Software.

Your Day-to-Day

As an Individual Contributor on the expert track, your responsibilities center entirely on deep technical ownership and execution:

Edge Infrastructure Ownership

  • Own the reliability and lifecycle of our edge racks: server hardware, network equipment, custom Linux-based OS, and the GPU-enabled Kubernetes layer running our AI classification services.

  • Design and improve automation for provisioning our growing fleet (50+ edge clusters and counting) using tools like Terraform, BMC/IPMI, and router APIs.

  • Maintain the secure network connecting edge deployments to our central cloud, and the tooling that enables safe software delivery to the fleet.

Reliability & Incident Management

  • Participate in the rotation of support on weekdays and own triage and resolution for escalated production issues.

  • Lead post-incident reviews and turn findings into lasting, automated fixes.

  • Define and monitor SLOs/SLIs/SLAs for physical edge systems running unattended in the field.

  • Extend our observability stack (Prometheus, custom hardware exporters, Grafana, Datadog) to catch issues proactively, often before customers notice.

Architecture, Collaboration & Craft

  • Set technical direction for edge infrastructure projects and contribute to technical planning and ticket writing.

  • Mentor fellow engineers through pairing, design/code reviews, and knowledge sharing, raising the technical bar without formal management authority.

  • Act as the top-level technical escalation point, personally helping resolve the most complex support and production issues.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders (with the eventual support of a Product Manager) to gather requirements and manage technical alignment.

  • Automate away repetitive manual work, applying the same rigor to internal tooling as to a customer-facing product.

Your Experience and Skills

  • Container Orchestration: Super proficient in maintaining Kubernetes on edge machines.

  • Programming: Fluency in at least one modern language, such as Golang or Python.

  • Monitoring: Deep understanding of concepts and tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.

  • Terraform is a native language to you.

  • Linux & Server Expertise: Deep proficiency in Linux-based systems and experience with server hardware, including components like RAID controllers BIOS, and Booting.

  • DevOps: Good understanding of release systems and proficiency with GitOps tools like Argo CD.

  • Security Management: Proficient in security concepts like certificate management (issuing, lifecycles, etc.) and secure network tunnels (e.g., IPSec/VPN).

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Holistic Data Center Engineering Expertise: Deep understanding of how to deal with low-level hardware like routers, switches, servers, BIOS, and TPM modules .

  • Bare-Metal Automation: Proven experience designing and implementing automation for bare-metal infrastructure provisioning.

  • Modern Kubernetes & CI/CD Architect: Moves beyond basic deployments to architecting sophisticated, automated, and resilient delivery pipelines using cutting-edge GitOps and Kubernetes-native tooling.

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with Terraform to build version-controlled, repeatable, and scalable environments.

Behavioral competencies

  • Strategic Thinker: You develop a clear vision and roadmap for the edge platform, considering its long-term health, scalability, and usability.

  • Strong Communicator: You build strong relationships with development teams and other stakeholders, communicate changes clearly, and secure buy-in.

  • High Ownership: You take end-to-end ownership of your technical output, including reliability, documentation, and continuous improvement.

  • Data-Driven: You use metrics on uptime, incidents, and support requests to prioritize the work that delivers the most value.

  • Customer-Focused: You keep developer and end-customer experience front of mind in your planning and execution.

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.

  • Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

  • Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.

  • Deutschland Ticket: Monthly subsidy towards public transportation costs.

Work-Life Integration:

  • Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.

  • WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!

  • 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.

  • Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.

  • Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.

Make a Difference:

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.

Your Team:

You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/

At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway!

What we offer

Interview Process

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. DeepL's translation portfolio is trusted by well over 20,000 companies and hundreds of millions of professionals worldwide. Rather than organizing our go-to-market by product line, we run a single integrated campaign that speaks to the different people who drive adoption of that portfolio organized by persona, not by feature set. As Integrated Campaigns Manager, you will own the persona motion targeting Global Operators, the department heads in Marketing, HR, and Learning & Development who are responsible for how their organizations communicate globally. Other campaign owners run the parallel motions for personas like Product, Engineering, and Developers; your job is to build the strategy, narrative, and channel mix for the Global Operators audience specifically.

This role sits at the intersection of integrated marketing, demand generation, and account-based marketing. You will start from how Marketing, HR, and L&D leaders think, communicate, and buy, then shape DeepL's capabilities into narratives and programs that speak directly to their priorities. You will orchestrate multi-channel campaigns from concept to launch, and partner closely with Product Marketing, SDR, and Field Marketing to bring targeted, personalized programs to personas in our highest-value accounts.. You will report to the Director of Performance Marketing and Campaigns and work cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content, Creative, Regional Marketing, and RevOps..

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Translate DeepL's translation capabilities into compelling, pipeline-driving campaigns tailored to how functional leaders operate and buy, educating the market on the value of AI-powered translation for global business communication.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, Field, Performance, and SDR teams to develop go-to-market programs and nurture streams aligned with persona priorities and regional needs.

Account-Based Marketing (ABM)

.

Measurement & Optimization

Cross-Functional Collaboration

About DeepL

Founded by researchers in 2017, we have developed the world's most accurate AI translation and writing technology — serving well over 20,000 companies and hundreds of millions of professionals worldwide.

Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

As an interim Senior QA Specialist at Rentman, you make sure every release reaches customers without regressions. You own the test strategy across our 3 product teams and finish moving regression testing from a manual release-day cycle to an automated, shift-left E2E suite. Without this role, quality depends on manual testing on release day, bugs show up in staging or production, and the move to automated testing stalls. This is an interim position: the duration is still to be confirmed, and the role ends once the assignment is complete.

What you'll do

  • Join refinement with the product teams and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests

  • Test new features on staging, going beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira

  • Write and review Playwright tests (TypeScript) in the frontend repo, and review developer-written tests in pull requests

  • Monitor the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions, triage failures the same day, and fix flaky tests at the root cause

  • Run release-day regression and the OWASP ZAP security scan for each release, and give a clear go / no-go call

  • Migrate the remaining legacy tests and decide what is worth automating and what stays manual

  • Organise cross-team QA days and coach developers so they own their tests

     

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years in QA on web applications

  • At least 2 years writing and maintaining UI test automation in code (Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, ideally TypeScript/JavaScript), not only record-and-play tools

  • Strong manual and exploratory testing, with bug reports developers can act on without follow-up questions

  • You have defined a test strategy (what to automate, what to test manually, coverage), not only executed test cases

  • Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions or similar)

  • You get developers to adopt new habits through pairing, good examples and clear specs, not by policing

     

Nice to haves

  • Experience with complex B2B SaaS

  • Playwright specifically, and Gherkin / BDD

  • Experience leading a shift-left change or coaching developers to own their tests

  • API testing (REST, Postman or similar)

  • 25 vacation days to recharge

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Our Opportunity:

Runtime Foundation owns the shared cloud foundations that every Snyk service runs on: production Kubernetes clusters, ingress and service mesh, infrastructure provisioning and access, cluster upgrades, reliability and disaster recovery, and our AWS and GCP core services. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction for this platform, lead our most ambiguous and consequential infrastructure work, and act as a trusted technical authority for teams across Snyk that depend on us.

You’ll spend your time:

  • Setting technical strategy for the platform, shaping the roadmap with engineering and product leadership, and making the case for investment in reliability, resilience and cost.

  • Leading cross-team, org-level infrastructure initiatives end-to-end, from problem framing and alignment through to production rollout and adoption.

  • Acting as a technical authority for engineering teams across Snyk, setting infrastructure design standards, reviewing significant proposals, and influencing how teams build securely and reliably on our platform.

  • Driving architectural direction for Kubernetes at scale, including cluster and node upgrade strategy, and leading diagnosis of deep networking, scheduling and resource-pressure issues in high-severity incidents.

  • Making multi-cloud (AWS/GCP) architecture decisions with long-term consequences, including IAM, networking and managed-service resilience.

  • Owning ingress, networking and service mesh architecture, including TLS, rate limiting and multi-tenant traffic design.

  • Have extensive professional experience (typically 5+ years) operating and architecting production infrastructure at scale, with a track record of leading work at organisation level rather than team level.

  • Can take an ambiguous, cross-organisational problem, define what success looks like, build alignment across teams without formal authority, and communicate trade-offs clearly to engineers, directors and executive stakeholders.

  • Have mentored and sponsored senior engineers, and have measurably raised the technical bar of a team or department.

  • Have designed or operated Teleport, RBAC, or JIT/least-privilege access systems at scale.

  • Have driven cloud cost optimisation outcomes, including tools like PerfectScale, and tied them to business impact.

  • Have built reusable CI/CD platform abstractions (CircleCI orbs, GHA reusable workflows, or similar) and driven org-wide adoption.

  • Have led disaster-recovery strategy, backup validation and recovery automation across Kubernetes and cloud services, including DR exercises with cross-team participation.

Leading a cross-functional team of around 20 people that includes product delivery managers, a product partnership person, a dedicated data person, and a PMM, you will scale Mollie’s cards capabilities beyond Europe, unlock new merchant categories, and ensure our proposition wins the hearts of highly sophisticated merchants. You will also work directly with payment schemes and external partners, making decisions that influence both the product roadmap and Mollie's broader positioning in the market.

The cards domain is expected to become an increasingly primary driver of Mollie's growth over time, with the potential for the online and in-person card acceptance platforms to converge and expand the scope of this role significantly. If you want to own something that matters at a company that is moving fast in the right direction, this is it.

So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

jobs.title: Projectmanager
jobs.description:
Met de Xpert Suite bieden ze bij Otherside at Work dé softwareoplossing op het gebied van duurzame inzetbaarheid en sociale zekerheid. Naast toonaangevende organisaties, werken veel arbodiensten en volmachtbedrijven met hun software. Je werk als Project Manager betekent dat je verantwoordelijk bent voor het op tijd, binnen budget én naar volle tevredenheid van alle stakeholders opleveren van hun implementatietrajecten bij klanten. Drie uitdagingen die jij natuurlijk graag aangaat. Het is dan ook jouw aard om altijd een beetje meer te geven dan de klant en je collega’s verwachten.

Taken

In deze super veelzijdige functie ben jij niet alleen het al-ziend-oog met betrekking tot het implementeren van hun software, maar denk jij ook mee met de software ontwikkeling en wensen van de klant. Jouw eigenschap dat je goed overzicht kan houden is handig, want je hebt meestal meerdere projecten tegelijk. Als de situatie daar om vraagt, ben jij in staat om een maatwerkaanpak voor jouw project te bedenken. Jij weet als geen ander het overzicht te behouden, prioriteiten te stellen en de klant tevreden te stellen met hun nieuwe oplossing. Nog niet genoeg uitdaging? We zijn ons internationaal aan het plaatsen, dus wie weet ga je ook in andere landen aan de slag.

Uiteraard ben je communicatief een kei. Je weet andere te inspireren en ben je in staat om de consultants en keyusers topprestaties te laten leveren (niet dat ze dat nog niet doen). Je vindt het leuk om creatieve en innovatieve oplossingen te bedenken die je samen met het projectteam bij de klant voorstelt. Je weet welke risico’s er komen kijken bij het uitrollen van dit soort projecten en hebt dan ook overal een passende, creatieve oplossing voor.

Doordat je al vanaf het sales traject aansluit bij de nieuwe klant kan je goed anticiperen op het project. Jij laat je dan ook niet uit het veld laat slaan als het even niet zo gaat als gehoopt, maar juist dan stroop je je mouwen op, breng je de juiste mensen bij elkaar en zorg je ervoor dat het ultieme doel bereikt wordt: een tevreden klant.

Doordat jij in control bent, kunnen de consultants hun werk beter doen. Ze weten wat er van hen verwacht wordt en hoe ze de klanten blij kunnen maken. Samenwerking, openheid en eerlijkheid en het managen van verwachtingen is hierin key. Een lolletje op zijn tijd en een goed gevoel voor humor doet de rest.

Vereisten

  • In het bezit van een HBO / WO diploma
  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie bij een software leverancier;
  • Je hebt doorzettingsvermogen en ziet (internationale) projecten als een uitdaging;
  • Je ben een enthousiaste doelgerichte teamspeler, waardoor zowel het projectteam als de klant jou graag ziet;
  • Andere kenmerken zijn: klantgericht, resultaatgericht, accuraat, doortastend en proactief;
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en goed in schriftelijk vastlegging;
  • Je kunt je vloeiend uitdrukken in het Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;
  • Je hebt goede kennis en ervaring met projectmanagement methodes zoals Prince2 en je bent ook bekend met Agile;
  • Je bent analytisch heel sterk en kunt snel problemen ontleden en oorzaken en/of samenhang van problemen vinden.

Deze eisen en vaardigheden geven een richting van het profiel dat wij zoeken voor deze functie. Voldoe jij niet aan alle eisen en vaardigheden maar denk je wel dat dit de functie voor jou is? Dan nodigen wij je graag uit om te solliciteren.

Benefits

  • Marktconform salaris
  • 5 weken vakantie met de mogelijkheid om bij te kopen.
  • Werken waar jij het beste tot je recht komt. Thuis, in de auto of op kantoor.
  • Ruimte voor nieuwe initiatieven en ideeën. Daar staan we altijd voor open. Of je nu net een week, maand of een jaar bij ons werkt.
  • Ongekend goede werksfeer. Met dagelijks een verzorgde lunch, maandelijkse borrels, legendarische Otherside at Work uitjes, kennis sessies om up to date te blijven en bordspelavonden.
  • Uitdagend werk om helemaal in op te gaan, zodat je af en toe vergeet dat je aan het werk bent.
  • Een platte organisatie in de breedste zin van het woord.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling en aanvullende verzekeringen (WGA Hiaat+ en WGA Excedent)
  • Gratis toegang tot het welzijnsplatform OpenUp, voor jou en je familie;
  • De mogelijkheid om een fiets te leasen via Otherside, met een maandelijkse werkgeversbijdrage.

Enthousiast?

jobs.title: UX Product Designer
jobs.description:
We are hiring a UX Designer who loves turning real user problems into clear, safe and well-tested designs, and who wants to shape how healthcare professionals work with AI every day.

Our Mission
Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App (web and mobile), we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.

Design is central to this vision. Our users are care professionals working with clients, not behind a desk. Every flow we build needs to be simple, fast and safe to use. And because the Attendi App is being certified as a medical device (MDR), we don’t just design what feels intuitive, we prove that users understand and use it as intended.

This isn’t about making it as easy as possible to order a pizza. It’s about how a care professional can receive AI-generated advice safely, and make sure they check what matters before they rely on it.

Your Role
As a UX Designer at Attendi, you will:

  • Translate user research into user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity designs for the Attendi App.

  • Work closely with our UX researcher, who uncovers user needs in the field, and turn those insights into the right solution.

  • Visit care organisations to test your designs with healthcare professionals: does this solution fit the problem we observed?

  • Design for safety in an AI product: identify where users could misuse or over-trust AI output, and design features that mitigate that risk.

  • Run usability studies as part of our MDR certification, through simulations, observation or A/B tests, and document what you tested and learned.

  • Work in two lanes: fast shipping of new features, and careful, well-documented work on our medical device track.

  • Work closely with the product owner, developers and our compliance team to get designs into production.

  • Help mature our design system in Figma.


You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

  • 2-4 years of experience as a UX or product designer in a product team, working in sprints.

  • Experience with B2B SaaS products.

  • You start with questions, not solutions: who is the user, what is their context, what problem are we really solving?

  • You balance a startup pace with taking a step back to research and test before going to production.

  • Strong Figma skills.

  • Native Dutch speaker. You’ll talk with healthcare professionals a lot, in their own language.

  • A portfolio that shows your thinking: the user, the problem, how you approached it and how you measured whether it worked.

Strong candidates may also

  • Have worked on AI products.

  • Have experience in healthcare, or another regulated environment such as legaltech, regtech or govtech.

  • Have worked on a CE-certified or medical device product, and know what that means for usability testing.

  • Have experience running usability studies or user interviews.

  • Enjoy working with a team for the long run and growing together with a scale-up.

What we offer

  • Salary between €4,000 and €4,500 per month, plus holiday allowance.

  • Ideally 40 hours per week.

  • Travel and lunch allowance.

  • Home office budget.

  • Lease bike.

  • Training budget of €1,500 per year.

  • Company MacBook.

  • ClassPass membership.

  • Pension contribution of 10% and roughly 7% paid by Attendi.

Our culture: People-oriented, curious, and proactive
At Attendi, you’ll work in a small, ambitious team that learns and builds together. We are empathetic, take initiative, dare to experiment, and stand by our work. Making mistakes is okay as long as you learn from them.

Application Process

  • Please include your portfolio with your application

  • Intro call with Roundr, our recruitment partner

  • Interview with a colleague from our design team

  • Case study: a short take-home assignment you present at our office

  • Offer and onboarding

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting), with 25+ nationalities and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our collective travel belts. What we have in common, beyond very well-worn passports, is this: We want to change the way people travel. That's exactly what we're doing, with the app that lets you plan, track, and relive every trip. Polarsteps has over 20 million users already. For us, this is just the beginning.

 

Your expedition: Product & Growth

 

This role is about the heartbeat of Polarsteps, the social layer that keeps travelers connected to the people who care about their journeys. You'll own the Social & Follower experience. Your users are followers & travelers; think about features that help travelers share what they're experiencing and help followers stay close from a distance. You are responsible for the engagement mechanics; think about how to make followers feel involved, not just informed, turning a passive audience into a real homefront community.

 

While innovating on this engagement, you will also be owning one of the most important growth loops of our business: the social viral loop. Here you'll be working closely working together with other teams that use the share flow, while also closely collaborating with our Growth & Marketing team who are in contact with resources like our Polarsteps Pioneers.

 

The social viral loop is one of Polarsteps' core growth engines, and it deserves both love (features that make sharing feel fun and effortless - like our route sharing feature) and brains (the thinking to optimize the numbers behind it). This is a role for someone who gets excited about optimizing the % in a growth loop and, in parallel, wants to grow product strategy skills on an important part of the travel experience while delivering a great experience to users.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

You will:

  • Own the Social & Follower experience end-to-end, from sharing functionality and growth loops to follower engagement features, likes, comments, and trip interaction.

  • Drive growth for key metrics: MAU, sharing rates, and social engagement, setting the bar and holding yourself to it.

  • Design and run experiments to validate ideas fast. You won't guess when you can test.

  • Work hand-in-hand with Growth & Marketing to align product initiatives with acquisition and retention goals, no silos, just shared wins.

  • Translate messy, complex problems into small, testable stories, making outcomes clear for everyone on the team.

  • Celebrate the small wins as much as the big ones. Incremental progress is still progress.

The equipment in your backpack

What we're hoping you'll bring with you.

✅ 5+ years of PM experience, ideally with time spent in a Growth PM role

✅ Genuinely data fluent; you move from hypothesis to experiment to decision without losing momentum. You treat every dataset as a chance to get sharper, not just to confirm what you already know.

✅ A solid understanding of UX/UI and creating a great (app) experience to drive product growth

✅ Experience working on app-first consumer products (B2C is your world)

✅ Growth and marketing-minded, you understand funnels, loops, and what makes people come back

✅ Humble, collaborative, and energized by team wins, this role doesn't work in a silo

✅ Bonus: experience with social or community features, or products where sharing is core to the experience

1st class extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organization. You'll set and execute the strategy for how we build revenue analytics across Salesforce and Looker, run insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business, partner closely with revenue leadership on the full range of topics they face, and, as you ramp up, take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

This is a generalist role by design: analytics is the foundation, especially in your first two quarters, and the role broadens from there to include business partnering and forecasting. What matters most is the versatility to move across all three, not depth in any single one.


What You'll Do

  • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

  • First 180 days: Build a highly automated revenue insights engine using AI, while establishing yourself as the business partner revenue leadership.

  • First 12 months: Broaden into leading and supporting the forecasting cadence.


What Will You Be Doing?

Revenue Analytics & Insights

  • Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order.

  • Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan.

  • Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider revenue leadership team rely on.

  • Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it.

  • Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep.

Business Partnership to Revenue leadership

  • Become the go-to Revenue Operations partner for revenue leadership, covering reporting, insights, and the broader range of topics that come up in running a sales organization.

  • Translate revenue leadership's open questions into structured analysis and clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Represent revenue's priorities into the Revenue Operations roadmap, and vice versa.

  • Support revenue leaders in business reviews, planning moments, and ad hoc requests with credible, fast turnaround.

Forecasting

  • Run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders alongside the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking.

  • Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion.

  • Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement.


What Will You Need to Succeed?

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue or Sales Operations, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

  • Exposure to Account Executive (AE) or similarly quota-carrying organization.

  • Strong Salesforce reporting skills and working fluency in a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), with a practical, business-first approach to data.

  • A genuine generalist mindset — as comfortable building a dashboard or an insights report, as running a forecasting call.

  • A track record of setting direction and quality bar for analytical work.

  • Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to work with and influence sales leadership and revenue executives.

  • Comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end: framing the question, choosing the method, landing the recommendation.

  • Excellent written communication — the insights digest is a core, ongoing deliverable of this role.

  • Experience partnering with global or multi-region teams is a plus.


What we Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.

Nous avons l'obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd'hui utilisés par des millions d'utilisateurs.

Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé.

Intégré.e au sein de l'équipe SQA, vous prendrez en main un banc de test physique déjà en production : il valide chaque nuit l'installation, la mise à jour et la configuration d'une vingtaine de modèles de produits Withings (balances, montres, tensiomètres…), pilotés en UART et relais, intégrés à notre CI Jenkins. Ce stage a pour but de penser, concevoir et produire une version améliorée permettant d'automatiser les interactions physiques — prendre une mesure, monter sur une balance, porter une montre, appuyer sur un bouton, vérifier ce que l'écran du dispositif affiche — afin de convertir en tests automatiques (python) les cas de tests exécutés à la main.

En forte interaction avec la QA Firmware, vos principales responsabilités incluront :

- Automatiser les mesures simulables : injection de mesures en dblib côté firmware, synchronisation réelle, vérification dans l'app.

- Explorer l'émulation de device : étudier et prototyper la simulation complète d'un produit sur Raspberry Pi (comportement BLE/Wi-Fi, cycle d'installation, génération de mesures)

- Étendre la couverture du banc existant : nouveaux modèles de produits, nouveaux scénarios (installation, firmware, synchronisation)

- Concevoir, modéliser et réaliser les jig de tests : impression 3D de supports et d'actionneurs, pilotage de relais et d'instrumentation série, lecture de l'état des dispositifs (écran, LED).

- Développer et maintenir les scripts d'automatisation en Python (Appium, pytest) qui orchestrent app mobile (iOS et Android), backend et instrumentation physique.

- Intégrer chaque nouveau scénario à la CI Jenkins pour qu'il tourne chaque nuit, et mesurer la réduction du volume de tests manuels qu'il permet.

- Travailler avec les outils d'aujourd'hui : l'équipe développe avec un harness d'agents de code (Claude Code…) — pipeline de génération de tests, revues assistées ; vous l'utiliserez et contribuerez à l'améliorer.

- Analyser les résultats, remonter les bugs et documenter les composants hardware et software ; participer aux revues de code.

Requirements

  • Vous êtes étudiant.e en dernière année d'une formation Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur ou université) et recherchez un stage de fin d'études ;
  • Une excellente maîtrise de Python est indispensable, notamment pour l'automatisation et l'interfaçage avec le hardware (ex : pyserial) ;
  • Des connaissances en conception mécanique et/ou en impression 3D (ex : FreeCAD, Fusion 360, Cura) seraient un atout majeur — le jig est autant mécanique que logiciel ;
  • Des bases en électronique (schémas simples, capteurs, relais, UART) seraient un plus ;
  • Une curiosité pour les agents de code (Claude Code, Codex…) est un plus ;
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les environnements MacOS et Linux ;
  • Vous êtes passionné.e par les produits high-tech innovants, l'IoT et les enjeux de la qualité logicielle et hardware ;
  • Vous êtes curieux.se, rigoureux.se, autonome, force de proposition et vous disposez d'une bonne capacité d'adaptation pour progresser dans un environnement en constante évolution ;
  • Vous êtes à l'aise pour communiquer vos idées et travailler en équipe ;
  • Vous maîtrisez l'anglais technique (lecture et écriture de code et de documentation).

Benefits

Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

  • Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
  • Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
  • Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
  • Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, réductions pour des activités culturelles et sportives, restaurant d’entreprise, et bien plus encore
  • Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites !


Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des opinions, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature.
