jobs.title: Ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE (Cloudflare One)
jobs.description:
À propos de Brixio

Brixio est un partenaire spécialiste de Cloudflare : intégration, services professionnels et services managés sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, de la sécurité applicative au SASE. Brixio est partenaire Cloudflare certifié ASDP et fait partie depuis juillet 2026 du groupe Equans (groupe Bouygues), 18,7 Md€ de chiffre d'affaires et environ 85 000 personnes.

L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans.

La mission

L'ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE déploie Cloudflare One chez les clients français de Brixio, du cadrage technique à la mise en production. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans.

Il travaille avec le Delivery Manager France, qui pilote le planning, le budget et la relation projet, et avec l'architecte principal, référent technique de l'équipe.

Responsabilités

  • Cadrage : animer les ateliers techniques avec les équipes réseau, sécurité et poste de travail du client, puis rédiger le design détaillé (architecture d'accès, politiques, plan de migration).
  • Déploiement Cloudflare One : Access (ZTNA), Gateway (SWG et filtrage DNS), client WARP, Tunnel, CASB, DLP, isolation de navigation (RBI), et selon les projets Magic WAN, Magic Firewall et Email Security.
  • Migrations : remplacer les VPN par du ZTNA et les proxies existants par Gateway, sans rupture de service pour les utilisateurs.
  • Intégrations : fournisseurs d'identité (Entra ID, Okta) en SAML, OIDC et SCIM, contrôles de posture (Intune, EDR), remontée des logs vers le SIEM du client.
  • OT et industrie : sécuriser l'accès distant des prestataires et techniciens aux équipements industriels et techniques.
  • Sécurité des usages IA : appliquer les contrôles Cloudflare One aux usages de l'IA (détection du shadow AI, DLP sur les prompts, gouvernance des applications IA).
  • Livraison et passation : documentation (HLD, LLD, runbooks), recette avec le client, passation au support et au MSP de Casablanca.
  • Rigueur projet : travailler dans le périmètre signé, signaler au Delivery Manager toute demande hors périmètre avant de la traiter, et saisir son temps chaque semaine dans Brixio One.
  • Industrialisation : contribuer aux modèles de déploiement réutilisables (configurations types, Terraform, playbooks) pour accélérer les projets suivants.

Requirements

Profil indispensable

Le poste demande d'être opérationnel sur le SASE dès les premières semaines. Sans expérience SASE en production, la candidature ne sera pas retenue.

  • SASE en production : au moins 2 ans de déploiements Zero Trust / SASE chez des clients, sur Cloudflare One, Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA), Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cato Networks ou Fortinet SASE.
  • Expérience : 3 à 6 ans en sécurité réseau, intégration ou services professionnels.
  • Fondamentaux réseau : TCP/IP, DNS, TLS et PKI, routage, VPN IPsec, proxies, pare-feu.
  • Identité : SSO en SAML et OIDC, provisioning SCIM, Entra ID ou Okta.
  • Poste de travail : déploiement d'agents à grande échelle, MDM et contrôles de posture.
  • Relation client : capacité à animer seul un atelier technique et à rédiger une documentation claire.
  • Langues : français courant, anglais professionnel (équipe internationale).
  • Mobilité : déplacements réguliers chez les clients en France, ponctuellement en Europe.

Atouts

  • Expérience directe de Cloudflare One, ou certification Cloudflare (sinon, à obtenir dans les 90 jours suivant l'arrivée).
  • Automatisation : Terraform, API, scripts Python.
  • Connaissance des environnements OT et industriels.
  • Connaissance des exigences NIS2 et DORA.
  • Intérêt pour l'IA et pour la plateforme développeurs de Cloudflare (AI Gateway, Workers).

Évolution et ce que Brixio offre

Le poste démarre sur le SASE mais ne s'y limite pas. Il s'ouvre ensuite aux autres produits Cloudflare (sécurité applicative, API Shield, Workers, IA), selon la progression et l'intérêt de la personne. La sécurité de l'IA s'appuie largement sur Cloudflare One, ce qui fait de ce poste une porte d'entrée naturelle vers les projets IA de Brixio.

  • Rémunération fixe selon profil, plus une part variable liée à des objectifs projet (qualité, respect des délais, saisie des temps).
  • Certifications Cloudflare prises en charge.
  • Projets variés chez des grands comptes, des ETI et les entités d'un groupe international.
  • Une équipe à taille humaine, avec la solidité du groupe Equans.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien de présentation avec le cabinet de recrutement.
  2. Entretien technique avec l'architecte principal, avec un cas pratique SASE (migration VPN vers ZTNA).

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

jobs.title: Principal / Senior Consultant EU Transport & Mobility (Project Delivery & Excellence)
jobs.description:
Panteia | Transport & Mobility | EU Policy & Research


About Panteia

Panteia is one of the Netherlands’ leading research and consultancy firms in the fields of transport, mobility and public policy. Headquartered in Zoetermeer, Panteia employs around 70 professionals and works for national governments, the European Commission, EU agencies  (CoR, CINEA), international institutions (e.g. EIB, World Bank, etc) and branch organisations.  Panteia is part of the PanMuc group, together with Revnext (digitalisation, cybersecurity, technology and innovation). Together, they form a growing European consultancy ecosystem operating at the intersection of transport, sustainability, economics and policy. Panteia also collaborates closely with partner consultancies across all 27 EU Member States.

Within the Transport & Mobility (T&M) unit, Panteia has built a strong and trusted position in EU projects, including policy studies, corridor studies, market studies, evaluations and impact assessments.

 

As Panteia’s EU transport and mobility portfolio continues to grow in scale and complexity, this role is created to anchor delivery quality and long-term excellence.

 

The role

To further strengthen delivery quality and execution excellence, Panteia is looking for a Principal Consultant EU – Project Delivery & Excellence.

This is a senior leadership role focused on the co-ordination, execution and quality assurance of complex EU-funded transport and mobility projects (research and consultancy). The role is designed for an experienced EU consultant who excels in structuring delivery, steering teams, managing risk, and ensuring that projects meet the highest professional  standards. A job for a policy-driven expert who wants impact and autonomy.

The Principal Consultant EU transport and mobility holds end-responsibility for delivery performance across a portfolio of EU projects and acts as a senior point of contact for clients and consortium partners.

 

Key responsibilities

Project delivery & leadership

  • Lead and oversee the execution of EU transport and mobility projects, including corridor studies, evaluations, impact assessments and policy research.

  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and in line with contractual and quality requirements.

  • Act as senior escalation point for delivery issues, client questions and consortium coordination.

  • Maintain strong working relationships with the European Commission, EU agencies and international partners.

 

Team & quality leadership

  • Steer and coach multidisciplinary project teams (internal consultants and external partners).

  • Safeguard consistency, methodological soundness and professional quality across deliverables.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal workflows, delivery standards and quality assurance processes.

 

Role in acquisition & transition

The Principal Consultant plays a key strategic role in shaping delivery approaches during tenders and proposals:

  • Shaping delivery concepts, work plans and governance structures in EU proposals.

  • Identifying delivery risks and mitigation strategies at proposal stage.

  • Ensuring a smooth and effective handover from acquisition to project execution.

 

Position in the organisation

  • Reports to: Team manager.

  • Team: Works closely with an international EU team of approx. 10–15 consultants, plus external consortium partners.

  • Leadership role: Senior delivery lead across multiple EU-funded projects, with high autonomy and responsibility.

 

Practicalities

  • Location: Zoetermeer (NL), hybrid model
    – Regular presence at HQ expected (approx. 3 days/week)
    – Occasional travel to Brussels and other EU locations.

  • Languages: English required; additional EU languages are an asset.

  • Start date: As soon as possible.

  • Package: Competitive salary, aligned with Dutch consultancy benchmarks.

 

Why join Panteia?

  • Work at the forefront of EU transport and mobility policy – from social aspects of transport, to transport infrastructure resilience.

  • Combine analytical depth with real policy impact.

  • Focus on delivery excellence rather than sales targets.

  • Work in a compact, expert-driven team.

  • Enjoy autonomy to shape how EU projects are delivered.

  • Join a respected, collaborative team with strong EU credentials.

  • Be part of a growing European consultancy ecosystem within PanMuc.


What Panteia is looking for:

  • 10+ years of experience managing EU-funded projects in transport, sustainability or policy consulting.

  • Proven track record in complex project execution within a multi-stakeholder environment.

  • Experience with policy studies, corridor studies, impact evaluations, stakeholder consultation, and socio-economic analysis.

  • Excellent team leadership and co-ordination skills.

  • Familiarity with DG MOVE, DG CLIMA or similar EU institutions and processes.

  • Strong communicator in English (spoken and written). Dutch or any additional EU language is a plus.

  • MSc or PhD in Transport Economics, Civil Engineering, Spatial Planning, Public Policy or related field.

  • Willingness to travel to Brussels and other EU locations when needed.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

As Omnea's Strategic Account Manager, you won't own a fixed book of accounts. Instead, you'll work across a large, shared pool of customers, 50+ at a time, and your job is to make every single one of them successful.

Unlike a traditional account role built around a handful of strategic relationships, you'll operate at scale: building Omnea's presence and community across your customer base through events, webinars, roundtables, and digital engagement, turning individual customers into a connected, invested group of Omnea advocates.

You'll still carry a commercial edge, owning retention and a smaller share of expansion across your pool, but the bulk of the role is about driving real value realisation and adoption at volume rather than running a small number of deep, high-touch relationships.

You're someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, is energised by variety, and knows how to prioritise ruthlessly. You're as comfortable hosting a roundtable for 30 procurement leaders as you are running a tight renewal call with a CFO.

What You'll Do

  • Own a large, shared pool of accounts: Manage 50+ accounts at a time across SMB and mid-market, not a fixed book, building relationships from end users (Procurement, Finance, Ops) through to senior stakeholders (CFOs, COOs), and stepping in early wherever you spot a health risk.

  • Drive value realisation, with a lighter expansion motion: Own Net Revenue Retention across your pool. Lead renewal conversations, secure multi-year extensions, and pass qualified upsell signal to Sales rather than running full commercial cycles yourself.

  • Build community and drive engagement at scale: Design and run customer events, webinars, roundtables, and digital programmes that keep your accounts engaged, informed, and connected to each other. Co-host with Marketing and Sales, and turn your best customers into reference champions.

  • Be the voice of the customer internally: Translate patterns across your accounts into product feedback for the roadmap, and into scalable plays and campaigns for Marketing and Sales. Help define the playbooks, tools, and processes for managing accounts at this scale: you're building this function as much as running it.

What's Different About This Role

  • This isn't a book-of-business role. You work across a large, shared pool of accounts rather than owning a fixed set, so leverage through events, content, and digital touchpoints matters as much as one-to-one relationship-building.

  • The quota skews toward retention and value realisation, not expansion. Roughly 70% of what you own is keeping accounts healthy and renewed; the other 30% is expansion you spot and hand off or close.

  • Community is core to the role, not a nice-to-have. You're expected to build and run the events, webinars, and content that turn a shared pool of customers into a connected group of Omnea advocates.

  • There's no fixed playbook for managing accounts at this scale yet. You'll help define it as you go.

About You

TL;DR: you're commercially sharp, energised by building community, and have the operational discipline to manage a high-volume, shared pool of accounts without letting anything slip. You know how to create leverage through events, content, and digital touchpoints, and you balance that with the relationship skills to make customers feel genuinely looked after.

  • 2-7 years of experience in a B2B SaaS commercial or customer-facing role. You might come from account management, customer success, marketing, or events - what matters is a genuine commercial edge and a track record of excellence in whatever you've done

  • You're a natural community builder: you know how to design and run programmes that bring customers together, and you understand how those moments translate into retention, expansion, and advocacy

  • You have strong commercial intuition: you can spot an expansion opportunity in a conversation, navigate a renewal proactively, and hold your own in commercial discussions with senior stakeholders

  • You're a brilliant communicator in every format: warm, clear, and credible whether you're hosting a webinar for 50 people or writing a customer newsletter

  • You're operationally excellent. Managing 50+ accounts at a time means ruthless prioritisation, tight organisation, and building systems and processes that create leverage

  • You're outcomes-focused with a heavy bias to action, entrepreneurial, and want to help build a business. The scope of this role will be defined by the person who takes it on

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

jobs.title: Director of Cybersecurity & IT
jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

Back Market is looking for a Director of Cybersecurity & IT to define and lead the next phase of our security and technology operations maturity. Reporting to the VP of Platform Engineering, you will be a strategic leader at the intersection of cybersecurity, IT, risk, compliance, and business growth.

You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization through its existing functional managers, creating the clarity, operating rhythm, and investment focus needed to protect Back Market while enabling the company to move quickly. The scope includes cybersecurity strategy and risk management, security operations, governance and compliance, IT operations, IT support, and the corporate technology foundations that keep our people productive and our business resilient.

 

This is a director-level role, not a super-sized operational manager role. You will not be expected to personally own every process or make every technical decision. Your impact will come from setting direction, developing leaders, aligning stakeholders, making sound investment choices, and ensuring that the organization delivers measurable outcomes. jobs.title: Product Line Manager
jobs.description:
About Wallee Group AG

Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers.

The Role

The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy.

In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products.

The Impact You’ll Make

  • Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes.

  • Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization.

  • Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives.

  • Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis.

  • Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals.

  • Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing).

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed.

  • Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk.

  • Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains.

  • Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs.

  • Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software.

  • Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus.

  • Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis.

  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach.

  • Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German.

Why Join Wallee?

  • Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready.

  • True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year.

  • Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters.

  • Growth & Culture: Competitive compensation, aligned with experience, seniority, and expertise, personal development budgets, and a social calendar filled with events.

  • The Perks: Fresh fruits, snacks, and high-quality coffee to keep you fueled.

Don’t tick every box? Neither do most great hires. If the role feels right, reach out, we’d love to see if we’re a match.

jobs.description:
Print & Copy Channel Business Unit

Locatie:

Deze hybride functie biedt de flexibiliteit om zowel vanuit ons kantoor in Almere als vanuit huis te werken.

Contract:

Het betreft een functie voor onbepaalde tijd, onder voorbehoud van de toepasselijke lokale arbeidswetgeving op basis van de standplaats van de kandidaat.

Scope:

Ondersteuning voor Single cluster (BnNe-regio)

Over ITS

Info Technology Supply Ltd (ITS) is een gerenommeerd softwarebedrijf met meer dan 38 jaar ervaring in de print- en documentmanagementindustrie in Europa en Noord- en Zuid-Amerika. Onze Business Unit Print & Copy Channel distribueert exclusief softwareoplossingen van toonaangevende leveranciers en ondersteunt een uitgebreid netwerk van meer dan 2.000 resellers en partners, verdeeld over zes regionale clusters.

Als het grootste PaperCut Authorised Solution Centre van Europa beschikken wij over een uitgebreid portfolio, waaronder PaperCut MF, NG, Hive en Pocket, evenals Umango, Willow360 en DocSlide. Daarnaast ontwikkelen wij diverse aanvullende modules die onze oplossingen verder versterken en uitbreiden.

Met vestigingen en activiteiten in het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Spanje, Nederland, België, Frankrijk, de DACH-regio en Oost-Europa zijn wij een werkelijk internationale organisatie. Tegelijkertijd behouden wij de persoonlijke betrokkenheid, korte lijnen en warme familiecultuur die ons al jarenlang kenmerken.

De Kans

Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische en snelgroeiende omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans om je technische expertise verder te ontwikkelen en onderdeel te worden van het Technical Services Team van een internationaal en innovatief softwarebedrijf.

Als Technical Support Consultant ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van technische ondersteuning en het uitvoeren van implementaties bij klanten binnen de BeNe-regio. Je werkt hybride vanuit ons kantoor in Almere, gecombineerd met thuiswerken.

Voor deze functie zoeken wij een enthousiaste en nauwkeurige professional met een proactieve instelling en een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen. Je bent in staat om klanten hoogwaardige technische ondersteuning te bieden en hen te begeleiden bij de implementatie en het beheer van onze oplossingen voor print-, scan- en documentmanagement.

Je werkt hierbij onder andere met producten uit ons portfolio, waaronder PaperCut, Umango, DocSlide en diverse andere innovatieve softwareoplossingen.

Belangrijkste Verantwoordelijkheden

Customer Support (Klantenondersteuning)

1. Het bieden van technische ondersteuning via de helpdesk, telefonisch, e-mail en via remote sessies en incidenteel onsite bij partners en/of eindklanten.

2. Het installeren en configureren van softwareoplossingen zoals PaperCut MF en Hive, Umango en DocSlide.

  6. Nauwe samenwerking met het Internationale iTS Supportteam.
  7. Technische en functionele interne Presales-vragen beantwoorden.
  8. Het creëren en uitvoeren van praktische technische trainingen en workshops voor partners.


Internal IT

1. Assisteren bij technische support aan collega's op zowel de software als de hardware die het bedrijf gebruikt.

2. Ondersteuning van de interne infrastructuur en diensten.

Vereiste kwalificaties

Ervaring & Achtergrond

  1. Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van het Nederlands en een goede beheersing van het Engels.
  2. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om gemakkelijk een goede relatie op te bouwen met klanten.
  3. Ervaring met print management oplossingen, zoals "Papercut" of scanoplossingen, is meegenomen.


4. Ervaring met Microsoft Windows Server- en clientplatformen, Active Directory, Entra ID en Microsoft SQL Server.

5. Ervaring met Windows-printservers, printwachtrijen en het uitrollen van printerdrivers is een pré.

6. Gedegen kennis van netwerken (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewallpoorten en SNMP) voor het oplossen van communicatieproblemen tussen servers, clients en printers.

7. Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met een gestructureerde aanpak van complexe technische vraagstukken.

8. Een proactieve instelling en het vermogen om nieuwe technologieën snel en zelfstandig eigen te maken.

9. In staat om zowel zelfstandig als effectief binnen een team te werken.

  1. Kan zowel zelfstandig als in team werken.


Pré

  1. Eerdere ervaring in een functie op het gebied van klantenservice of technische ondersteuning.
  2. Kennis van PaperCut-functionaliteiten zoals Find-Me Printing, Print Deploy, Mobility Print en scanworkflows (scan-to-email, scan-to-folder en scan-to-cloud).
  3. Ervaring met het configureren van embedded software en kaartlezers op multifunctionele printers van merken zoals Canon, Ricoh, Konica Minolta, Kyocera of HP.
  4. Ervaring met andere print- en scanmanagementoplossingen, zoals Equitrac, uniFLOW of YSoft SAFEQ.
  5. Een PaperCut-certificering, bijvoorbeeld PaperCut Certified Engineer.
  6. Ervaring met virtualisatieplatformen en Microsoft Azure.
  7. Bekendheid met macOS en Linux.


Wat wij aanbieden

Wij geloven dat plezier in je werk net zo belangrijk is als goede arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Daarom bieden wij:

1. Een uitdagende functie binnen een internationale organisatie.

2. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

3. Hybride werken vanuit huis en/of ons kantoor in Almere.

4. Een auto van de zaak.

5. Laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

6. Een aantrekkelijk salaris passend bij jouw ervaring.

7. 25 vakantiedagen.

8. Uitgebreide opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringsmogelijkheden.

9. Een team van collega's dat elkaar ondersteunt en kennis deelt.

10. Ruimte om door te groeien richting consultancy, projectmanagement of specialistische technische rollen.

Bedrijfsbeschrijving

ITS Benelux maakt deel uit van de internationale ITS Group, een organisatie die al meer dan 35 jaar actief is en klanten ondersteunt in Europa, Noord-Amerika en daarbuiten.

Maar wat je vooral merkt als collega, is dat we ondanks onze internationale omvang een nuchtere en persoonlijke organisatie zijn gebleven.

We werken hard, helpen elkaar, vieren successen samen en geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen zich prettig voelen op hun werk.

Hier ben je geen nummer, maar een belangrijk onderdeel van het team.

Voel je vrij om its-group.com en printandcopycontrol.com te bezoeken om meer te weten te komen over ons bedrijf en productportfolio.

iTS is gecertificeerd volgens de ISO 9001:2015- en ISO/IEC 27001:2022-normen.

Bedrijfswaarden

Klantgericht: We streven ernaar om te zorgen dat aan de behoeften van onze klanten worden voldaan en overtroffen, en bouwen sterke, langdurige relaties op.

Flexibel & Loyaal: We investeren tijd, energie en middelen in het koesteren van onze relaties, met als doel langdurig succes.

Internationaal team met een gezinsgeest: Onze bedrijfscultuur hecht waarde aan samenwerking, waardering en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en biedt een waardevolle omgeving waar iedereen kan floreren.

ITS is niet:

Arrogant

Arrogantie laat mensen geloven dat ze altijd het beste weten. Het stopt het constante leren dat succes vereist. Wij zien arrogantie als het begin van het einde van elke organisatie.

Om te solliciteren

Denk je dat dit bij je past?

Mooi. Dan hoeven we niet per se een perfect CV te zien.

Ben jij technisch nieuwsgierig, klantgericht en heb je zin om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Graag ontvangen wij jouw cv, inclusief een motivatiebrief waarin je beschrijft:

1. Je praktische technische ervaring met PaperCut of andere producten binnen het ITS-portfolio, inclusief de omgevingen waarin je deze hebt geïmplementeerd, ondersteund of beheerd.

2. Voorbeelden van technische, presales- en adviesactiviteiten waaraan je hebt bijgedragen of die je hebt geleid, zoals solution design, productdemonstraties en aanbestedingstrajecten.

3. Je taalvaardigheden en, indien van toepassing, je kennis van de clusterregio en het bijbehorende partnernetwerk.

iTS is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt en zich inzet voor het opbouwen van een divers en inclusief team.

TL;DR

You know how to walk into an enterprise, spot the pain points in its ERP processes, and see what good could look like. At Conduct you turn that into a game changing moment: you show leadership, with confidence, how Conduct will transform the way they run SAP. You own optimising the delivery of transformation projects with Conduct, from the first use case to adoption across the business. You build the trust that turns a pilot into a long-term partnership, and the product insights you bring back directly shape what we build next.

Why Conduct

The world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the systems they run on. Today they don't, and you've seen why firsthand.

Every new product line, pricing change or process redesign runs into SAP estates layered with decades of custom code, user exits and enhancements no single person fully understands. Requirements take months to ship. S/4HANA migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain, and the 2027 ECC deadline is forcing every large enterprise to face it.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems. We've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

What you'll own

You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks inside our most strategic SAP customers. You join accounts early, shape how Conduct fits into their transformation programmes, and fully take over post-sale. You'll have a direct line from what you see in the field to what ships in the product.

  • Be the SAP brain in the room. Translate between CIOs, process owners, Basis teams and our engineers. Scope use cases across finance, supply chain, procurement and sales that land real value fast.

  • Design the transformation. Get under the skin of complex, heavily customised ECC and S/4HANA landscapes. Conceptualise where Conduct can have the biggest impact, then lead the deployment that gets the customer there.

  • Turn pilots into partnerships. Onboard hundreds of end users, prove ROI, spot expansion signals and hold the early commercial conversations that grow an account.

  • Shape the product. You'll have a direct line into product and engineering. Your view of how SAP actually runs in the real world will shape our roadmap.

  • Build the engine. Our GTM team is small and lean. You'll build the onboarding flows, tooling and reusable playbooks that let customer capacity compound without headcount growing linearly.

  • Work with our SI partners. You speak their language. Help partners deploy Conduct inside their own programmes.

No two days look the same. You'll fly out to customers when it counts and spend the rest of the time building alongside the team.

Who we hire

jobs.description:
About us

At Pencil, we are building the AI Operating System for marketing — the only enterprise platform that aggregates every leading AI model, enforces enterprise-grade governance, and turns creative production savings into media growth. Your mission

Bring the craft of advertising together with the speed of GenAI. Reporting and partnerships

Creative production

jobs.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The role

As a Strategic Account Manager, you’ll own our largest accounts — the global banks, top-tier law firms, multi-strategy hedge funds, asset managers, and private equity firms. This is a rare combination of Account Management and Enterprise Sales: you’ll be the trusted senior relationship owner for the account and the commercial lead responsible for expanding 9fin into every relevant team, desk, and geography inside it.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Owning the end-to-end relationship and commercial success of a small portfolio of 9fin’s largest most complex accounts, including global banks, top-tier law firms, hedge funds, asset managers and PE sponsors.

  • Acting as the senior point of contact and trusted advisor for MDs, Partners, PMs, Heads of Desk and C-suite stakeholders — building deep, multi-threaded relationships across each organisation.

  • Building and executing strategic account plans that map the org, identify white space, and lay out a clear path to materially growing ARR over multi-year horizons.

  • Driving expansion by qualifying and closing new opportunities inside your accounts, new teams, new desks, new asset classes, new geographies — running full enterprise sales cycles alongside your renewal motion.

  • Leading commercial negotiations on multi-year renewals, uplifts and enterprise agreements, partnering with Legal and Finance and on complex procurement and MSA processes.

  • Deeply understanding each client’s workflows in credit, leveraged finance, restructuring, distressed and private credit, and translating those into concrete use cases 9fin can solve.

  • Partnering closely with Product and Engineering to bring the voice of your clients into the roadmap — you are their most credible advocate internally.

  • Representing 9fin externally at client offsites, executive briefings, industry conferences and roundtables, becoming a recognised name in debt markets.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Have 7+ years managing and growing strategic enterprise accounts, ideally selling data, SaaS, research or workflow platforms into global banks, buy-side firms, or law firms.

  • Have a proven track record of owning multi-million-dollar accounts and materially expanding them — you can point to specific accounts you’ve grown from $X to $Y and explain exactly how.

  • Combine the depth of a top-tier Account Manager with the commercial edge of a top-tier Enterprise Account Executive — you’re equally comfortable running a strategic QBR with an MD and closing a net-new expansion into a team that’s never used 9fin.

  • Have credibility with senior stakeholders in debt or credit markets, whether from selling to them, working in the industry, or both, and a genuine intellectual interest in the space.

  • Are commercially sharp and operationally rigorous: skilled at navigating complex procurement, legal review, executive alignment, and internal cross-functional work at scale.

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

 

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity options

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

 

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

jobs.title: Afstuderen: Integratie van machine data voor resourceplanning
jobs.description:
WAT GA JE DOEN?

Bij onze internationale klanten wordt voor de dagelijkse productie gebruikgemaakt van verschillende LogicSteel software applicaties. LogicSteel MRP ondersteunt hierbij operationele processen, zoals het plannen van productie, het beheren van projecten, inkooporders en het aansturen van medewerkers. Daarnaast zijn er systemen zoals Insights die machine- en prestatiegegevens inzichtelijk maken. Doordat informatie verdeeld is over meerdere applicaties, ontbreekt vaak één centraal overzicht voor resourceplanning en capaciteitsbeslissingen.

Tijdens deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je hoe relevante gegevens uit deze systemen beter gecombineerd en gepresenteerd kunnen worden, zodat gebruikers sneller de juiste inzichten hebben voor het plannen van mensen, machines en productiecapaciteit.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het analyseren van het huidige resourceallocatieproces en de rol van machine- en productiegegevens hierin;

  • Het voeren van interviews met gebruikers om hun doelen, behoeften en knelpunten in kaart te brengen;

  • Het onderzoeken welke data uit Insights en MRP relevant is voor besluitvorming;

  • Het analyseren van gebruikersstromen, beschikbare data en bestaande schermen;

  • Het ontwikkelen van wireframes, gebruikersflows en ontwerpconcepten;

  • Het valideren en verbeteren van ontwerpen door middel van feedbacksessies met gebruikers en stakeholders;

  • Het vertalen van gebruikersbehoeften naar functionele requirements;

  • Het opstellen van een advies voor de integratie en presentatie van machinegegevens over verschillende platformen.

Het eindresultaat is een onderbouwd ontwerp- en implementatievoorstel waarmee gebruikers sneller en beter onderbouwde beslissingen kunnen nemen op het gebied van resourceplanning en machinebezetting.


WIJ VRAGEN

  • HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van UI/UX Design, Human Computer Interaction, Interaction Technology of vergelijkbaar.

WIJ BIEDEN

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

  • Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek.

jobs.title: Customer Success Associate
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 What you will do:

As a Customer Success Associate in EMEA, you will play a key role in scaling and strengthening our international post-sales experience as part of a growing global Customer Success organization. You will serve as a strategic advisor to a portfolio of mid-market customers, partnering directly with technical and business stakeholders to drive adoption, value realization, retention, and growth.

You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support while helping shape and evolve the Customer Success experience across the EMEA region.

We are open to candidates based in the Netherlands who are willing to work in a hybrid model, at least 1 day per week in our Amsterdam office.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of EMEA mid-market customers as their primary post-sales technical advisor, developing a deep understanding of the NodeZero platform to guide successful adoption

  • Cultivate champions with security leaders—from analysts to CISOs—and guide them through the lifecycle of adoption, expansion, and advocacy

  • Deliver technical onboarding and enablement to drive adoption of NodeZero, including advanced features like Tripwires, Insights, and Rapid Response, ensuring customers realize maximum value

  • Proactively identify customer needs and potential challenges, suggesting solutions that improve their experience and enhance their cybersecurity posture

  • Partner closely with IT and Security teams (SOC, red/blue teams, AppSec, etc.) to help interpret pentest results, prioritize remediation, and guide long-term offensive security strategy

  • Collaborate closely with Sales and Renewals teams to drive retention and growth by identifying expansion opportunities, aligning on account strategy, and ensuring a seamless renewal process

  • Act as a customer advocate, relaying customer feedback and technical issues to our internal teams to help drive the evolution of our product and services

  • Conduct regular check-ins and quarterly business reviews to align on strategy, secure executive buy-in, and showcase business outcomes.

  • Contribute to documentation, training materials, and repeatable playbooks to scale technical success across the region

  • Maintain detailed records of customer health and touchpoints using internal CS platforms

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Client Services, within a SaaS cybersecurity environment

  • In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity practices and principles

  • Deep understanding of enterprise security, information technology, cloud, or offensive security is highly preferred

  • Strong customer acumen—able to align solutions to business priorities and present clearly to both technical and executive stakeholders

  • Experience managing a book of business with revenue targets (ARR, NRR, GRR)

  • Startup or high-growth company experience is preferred; you thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

  • Location: based in the Netherlands and able to work in a hybrid model, at least 1 day per week in our Amsterdam office

  • Comfortable with tools like Salesforce, Gainsight, and JIRA; detail-oriented and organized

  • English fluency required; fluency in French, Spanish, or German preferred

 

Perks of Horizon3.ai

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Depending on experience, the compensation range for this position is: €70,000 - €85,000 OTE 80/20 split annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

jobs.description:
Business Development Team Lead (m/w/d)

B2B SaaS | Berlin | Leadership & Outbound Sales

Für ein stark wachsendes, international tätiges B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen suchen wir im Rahmen eines exklusiven Suchmandats einen Business Development Team Lead (m/w/d) für den Standort Berlin.

Das Unternehmen befindet sich in einer dynamischen Wachstumsphase und baut seine kommerzielle Organisation weiter aus. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Verantwortung für ein bestehendes Business-Development-Team und entwickelst dieses sowohl operativ als auch strategisch weiter.

Gesucht wird dabei ausdrücklich kein rein administrativer Team Lead. Du solltest aus dem Outbound Sales kommen, erfolgreiche Vertriebsansätze selbst angewendet haben und in der Lage sein, diese Erfahrung sehr praxisnah an dein Team weiterzugeben.

Deine Aufgabe

Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines Teams von Business Development Representatives und entwickelst dieses zu einer leistungsstarken Outbound-Organisation weiter.

Dabei gehören insbesondere folgende Themen zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich:

  • Leadership & Coaching: Du führst, motivierst und entwickelst deine BDRs kontinuierlich weiter und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre individuellen Ziele zu erreichen und perspektivisch den nächsten Karriereschritt zu gehen.

  • Hands-on Sales Coaching: Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team im Tagesgeschäft, analysierst Calls und Outreach-Aktivitäten und vermittelst konkrete Methoden und Best Practices aus deiner eigenen Vertriebserfahrung.

  • Performance Management: Du steuerst das Team anhand relevanter KPIs, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Qualität und Produktivität ab.

  • Outbound Excellence: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Prospecting-Ansätze, Messaging, Playbooks und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Teamaufbau: Du unterstützt bei Recruiting und Onboarding neuer BDRs und stellst sicher, dass neue Teammitglieder schnell produktiv werden.

  • Sales Strategy: Du arbeitest eng mit dem weiteren Sales Leadership sowie angrenzenden Teams zusammen und übersetzt Markt- und Kundenfeedback in wirkungsvolle Akquisitionsstrategien.

  • Customer Focus: Du stellst sicher, dass das Team trotz hoher Outbound-Aktivität einen professionellen, beratenden und kundenorientierten Vertriebsansatz verfolgt.

Was du mitbringen solltest

Wir suchen eine Person mit einem starken operativen Sales-Background und erster bzw. fundierter Führungserfahrung in einem ambitionierten B2B-Vertriebsumfeld.

Besonders relevant sind:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Business Development / Sales Development / Outbound Sales

  • Erfahrung im B2B-Umfeld, idealerweise in SaaS, Tech oder einem vergleichbar dynamischen Geschäftsmodell

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau, Coaching oder in der Führung von SDR-/BDR-Teams

  • Sehr gutes Verständnis moderner Outbound-Methoden und Sales-Prozesse

  • Erfahrung mit KPI- und datenbasierter Vertriebssteuerung

  • Ausgeprägte Coaching-Mentalität und Freude daran, andere Vertriebler besser zu machen

  • Fähigkeit, eigene Sales-Erfahrung in konkrete Methoden, Playbooks und Trainings zu übersetzen

  • Hoher Qualitätsanspruch bei gleichzeitig pragmatischer und umsetzungsorientierter Arbeitsweise

  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

Was die Rolle besonders macht

Die Position bietet deutlich mehr Gestaltungsspielraum als eine klassische Team-Lead-Rolle.

Du übernimmst ein Team in einer wichtigen Wachstumsphase und kannst unmittelbar beeinflussen, wie Outbound Sales organisiert, gesteuert und weiterentwickelt wird. Gleichzeitig arbeitest du eng mit dem Management und der kommerziellen Führung des Unternehmens zusammen.

Die Rolle eignet sich besonders für jemanden, der weiterhin nah am operativen Vertrieb bleiben möchte und Spaß daran hat, ein Team nicht nur zu managen, sondern durch Coaching, Struktur und eigene Sales-Erfahrung messbar besser zu machen.

Das Unternehmen

Unser Mandant ist ein wachstumsstarkes europäisches Technologieunternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Berlin. Das Unternehmen bietet eine B2B-Softwarelösung für mittelständische Unternehmen und hat sich in den vergangenen Jahren erfolgreich in mehreren europäischen Märkten etabliert.

Das internationale Team arbeitet in einem leistungsorientierten Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hohem Gestaltungsspielraum und einer ausgeprägten Ownership-Kultur.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Standort: Berlin

  • Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid mit klarem Fokus auf die Zusammenarbeit vor Ort

  • Rolle: Führungsverantwortung für ein Business-Development-Team

  • Umfeld: Internationales B2B-SaaS-/Tech-Unternehmen in einer starken Wachstumsphase

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: mit dem Sales Leadership und weiteren relevanten Stakeholdern

Die Suche wird von uns im Rahmen eines direkten Recruiting-Mandats begleitet. Weitere Informationen zum Unternehmen, zur Teamstruktur und zum Auswahlprozess teilen wir gerne im persönlichen Austausch.

About the Role

As our Senior Partner Manager DACH, you'll own and grow Tellent's partner ecosystem across the DACH market. You'll inherit an established network of reseller and referral partners, including a group of key strategic partners with significant growth potential — and your role is to turn that foundation into a stronger, more predictable source of pipeline and revenue.

You'll build trusted relationships with key partners, create joint growth plans, identify whitespace opportunities across their customer base, and hold partners accountable for execution. At the same time, you'll identify and recruit new high-potential partners, particularly within the HR ecosystem. This is a senior individual contributor role: you'll operate with significant ownership, treating the DACH partner business almost like your own business and bringing a clear point of view on where the market can grow.

You will report to the VP Partnerships.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • During the first 3 months: You build a strong understanding of the DACH partner ecosystem, establish relationships with key partners and Sales stakeholders, and define a clear plan for where to focus your time and investment.

  • Within 6 months: You're independently managing the partner portfolio, driving joint business plans with key partners, generating quality pipeline, and identifying new partner opportunities.

  • After 1 year: You're driving predictable partner-sourced pipeline and revenue across DACH, growing the strategic partner portfolio, and expanding the ecosystem with new partners that contribute meaningful business.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Strategic Partner Management: Own and grow Tellent's most impactful DACH partner relationships, building long-term relationships and joint business plans focused on mutual growth.

  • Partner Performance: Monitor partner health, pipeline and revenue performance, identify risks early, and hold partners accountable to agreed activities and results.

  • Commercial Growth: Generate partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, improve opportunity quality and conversion, and ensure strong collaboration with Sales throughout the deal cycle.

  • Account & Whitespace Planning: Work side by side with strategic partners to analyse their customer base, identify whitespace opportunities and build plans to generate new business together.

  • Partner Acquisition: Identify, qualify and recruit high-potential new partners, particularly across the HR ecosystem, assessing them based on strategic fit and revenue potential.

  • Activation & Enablement: Ensure new and existing partners are effectively enabled on Tellent, our products, ICP and sales approach, and turn partnerships into active commercial relationships.

  • Market Development: Bring a strong point of view on the DACH market, identifying opportunities beyond the existing partner ecosystem and translating ideas into concrete execution.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, particularly the DACH Sales team, as well as Marketing and other Partnerships colleagues to improve deal execution, campaigns, enablement and pipeline quality.

  • Operational Excellence: Identify recurring friction in the partner GTM motion and contribute to improving playbooks, cadences, partner planning and ways of working across the wider Partnerships team.

What You Bring

  • Partnership Experience: Several years of experience in a partner, channel or business development role, with a proven track record of building and growing strategic partner relationships.

  • DACH Market Expertise: Strong understanding of the German market and ideally an established network of relevant DACH partners.

  • SaaS Experience: Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within HR tech or an adjacent mid-market/SMB environment.

  • Commercial Skill: Strong understanding of pipeline generation, forecasting, partner planning and commercial performance, with experience in reseller and/or referral models.

  • Strategic Thinking: Able to assess a partner portfolio, identify where the biggest opportunities are, and make clear decisions about where to invest time and resources.

  • Execution: You don't just have ideas — you turn them into structured plans, actions and measurable results.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: You take ownership of the DACH partner business as if it were your own, proactively looking for opportunities and challenging existing assumptions.

  • Relationship Building: Strong at building trusted relationships while also being comfortable setting expectations, challenging partners and addressing underperformance.

  • Self-Management: Highly organised and able to manage a broad portfolio, prioritising time effectively across partners, Sales and new opportunities.

  • Communication: Professional fluency in German and English, comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and operating across cross-functional teams.

  • Travel: Comfortable travelling regularly across Germany to build and maintain strong in-person partner relationships.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working in the Cologne area as we continue building our local team presence

  • Diverse and international team environment

  • €1,500 annual learning budget

  • Pension scheme & wellness/fitness benefits

  • Country-specific holiday policies apply

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year

  • Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed

  • Home office budget and allowance

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.

jobs.description:
About the role:

As a Learning Experience Architect at Quantum Systems, you will work with our Training & Demo Team to shape learning around our unmanned systems (UxS). You will help our international customers and employees understand complex technology and use it safely.

You will define the instructional approach for our training portfolio and support its implementation. Working with trainers and subject matter experts, you will digitize and scale existing training and develop new offerings. You will combine digital learning with practical exercises and assess how well learners can apply what they have learned.

You will have the freedom to take your ideas from concept to launch and put your own stamp on UxS training at Quantum Systems. Your work will improve the technical and instructional quality of our training and make its impact measurable.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • You will design modular learning paths that combine digital self-study with instructor-led training and simulator exercises.

  • You will turn technical expertise into interactive learning modules and assessments and coordinate media production.

  • You will build scalable offerings in learning management systems such as Moodle and define standards for quality and reusable content.

  • You will test learning concepts with target users and improve them using feedback, usage data and learning results.

  • You will evaluate learning outcomes and practical application and use the findings to improve our training portfolio.

  • You will advise and support our trainers in using effective instructional methods for digital and blended learning.

  • You will prioritize portfolio improvements and deliver learning projects with UxS experts, the Simulator Team and external providers.

  • You will analyze learning needs and define measurable objectives for new and existing offerings with the Training & Demo Team.



What you bring to the team:

  • You have a degree in education, instructional design, media or e-learning, or a comparable qualification with relevant practical experience.

  • You have solid experience in adult learning and modular, digital and blended learning, demonstrated through project examples or a portfolio.

  • You can analyze learning needs, define measurable objectives and test learning concepts with target users.

  • You are proficient in authoring tools and experienced in designing and publishing digital learning in learning management systems such as Moodle.

  • You know how to evaluate learning outcomes and practical application and use feedback and learning data to drive improvements.

  • You can understand complex technical topics, explain them clearly with subject matter experts and advise trainers on new learning formats.

  • You work independently and methodically and coordinate learning projects with different stakeholders.

  • You have excellent written and spoken German and English communication skills.

  • Experience with AI in learning, media design (images, audio, video) or learning management system administration is a plus.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations.

At Quantum Systems, you’ll work alongside experts across disciplines, take ownership from day one and help turn ambitious ideas into technology with real-world impact. We move fast, think beyond boundaries and give our teams the space to shape what comes next.

The Future is Unmanned - But the responsibility is not.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

jobs.title: (Senior) Principal Mendix Developer
jobs.description:
Excited to lead teams and architect Mendix solutions that are scalable, future-ready and make a real difference?

At Valcon, we help organisations across Europe become fit for the future – combining consulting, data and technology to realise real transformation. We work end-to-end: from boardroom strategy to concrete implementation on the work floor. Our approach is pragmatic, fast and collaborative. No buzzwords, just results.

Our culture is defined by ownership, entrepreneurship and continuous learning. We believe in growing together – through mentorship, trust and the freedom to shape your own path. We offer flexibility, challenge, and the opportunity to work on projects that matter.

You’ll join our fast-growing Low-Code capability, with over 100 Mendix professionals across Europe – including 26 experts and 3 MVPs in the Netherlands alone. Our team works on high-impact projects for clients like IND/COA, Prorail, Defensie, BAM, Heineken with a strong focus on collaboration, quality and long-term solutions. Many of our projects are international – such as our recent engagement in Denmark, where our hybrid team (NL, DK, KR) delivers scalable solutions from design to delivery. Whether you want to specialise, coach others or lead engagements: you’ll find the space and support to grow.

Tasks

What will you do?

As a (Senior) Principal Mendix Consultant, you bring together strategic thinking, platform expertise and strong leadership. You’ll lead multidisciplinary project or DevOps teams with full end-to-end ownership – from uncovering client needs to delivering scalable, future-ready applications.

You take the lead in workshops, architecture and design decisions, translating complex business challenges into impactful IT-solutions – ranging from mobile and workflow apps to data-driven and integrated platforms. Increasingly, you’ll work on solutions that leverage AI, smart automation and advanced integrations to unlock new business value.

Beyond delivery, you’ll play a key role in shaping our Low-Code capability. You help scale teams, raise engineering standards, and contribute to strategy, talent development and internal best practices. As a technical lead, you’re also actively involved in pre-sales, shaping proposals and leading proof-of-concepts for new clients.

Depending on your interests, you can further grow towards strategic client ownership, technical depth or mentoring responsibilities – always with the freedom to shape your own path.

Among your responsibilities will be the following:

  • Designing, developing and testing innovative Mendix solutions in an agile way.
  • Leading multidisciplinary teams and acting as technical lead in delivery projects: guiding architecture, workshops, design decisions, and quality
  • Leading and coaching multiple Mendix teams, sometimes across different clients and domains.
  • Tackling complex technical challenges and shaping long-term platform strategies.
  • Coaching developers and consultants to grow their skills and confidence with the Mendix platform.
  • Supporting pre-sales activities and helping shape client proposals and proof-of-concepts.
  • Strengthening our Low-Code capability through improved standards, best practices and strategic team development.

Requirements

Experience:

  • A completed Bachelor’s, Master’s or technical HBO degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, Econometrics, Mathematics or a related field.
  • At least 4 years of working experience as Mendix specialist/application developer and Mendix Advanced Developer certification.
  • Nice to have: Mendix Expert Developer Certification and/or a specialisation in a domain like UI/UX, Architecture or custom (react/java) development.
  • Fluent in Dutch and English
  • Located in The Netherlands

Benefits

What do we offer you?

  • Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.
  • An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.
  • Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself.
  • Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance.
  • A company car or mobility budget.
  • A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).
  • An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.
  • The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.
  • A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.

Ready to apply?

Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values – Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity – resonate with you?

Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

 

About You

Most AE roles ask you to sell a product you only half understand to buyers who already know they want it. This is not that role. You'll sell a deeply technical product to developers, CTOs, and product teams — people who can smell a script from a mile away and will respect you more for going deep on the tech than for any closing line you've practiced. We don't have a polished playbook handed down from a head of sales who left three companies ago. We have a new sales leader, a market that's exploding faster than we can keep up with, and a real opportunity for the right person to help define the motion from the inside.

If you're energized by ambiguity, allergic to bureaucracy, and the kind of seller who genuinely enjoys learning why a customer is building what they're building — keep reading.

You'll thrive as an Account Executive if you:

  • are obsessed with making the best product for our customers

  • are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

  • work hard and can build and ship fast

  • are focused on polish, detail and quality

  • are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd implement LiveKit, and potentially tinkering with it 😊

 

What You'll Do

  • Own and manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to demos, negotiation, and close

  • Develop deep product understanding and communicate technical value to developers, CTOs, and product teams

  • Generate pipeline through outbound efforts and strategic partnerships, with support from marketing and sales development

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with prospects and customers, identifying their goals and how our platform helps them succeed

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to bring customer feedback into roadmap discussions and positioning

  • Help shape and evolve our sales playbook, messaging, and GTM motion as one of the earliest sales hires

  • Accurately forecast and track pipeline activity, working closely with leadership to inform strategy and planning

 

Who You Are

  • 4+ years of full-cycle SaaS sales experience, with at least 2 of those years selling into enterprise

  • A track record of consistently selling 6-figure deals and hitting or exceeding quota in fast-paced or early-stage environments

  • Strong instincts for selling technical products — APIs, developer tools, or infrastructure tooling — you don't shy away from going deep with technical buyers

  • Comfortable in low-process, high-autonomy environments and bringing structure where it's missing

  • Able to translate technical capability into business value for both technical buyers and executive stakeholders

  • High accountability, ownership, and bias for action — you don't wait to be told what the right next move is

  • Disciplined with CRM and pipeline hygiene (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling at an infrastructure or developer-tools company, ideally with multi-product or platform sales motion

  • Time spent as one of the earliest sellers at a startup — you know what it feels like to build the plane while flying it

  • A real interest in voice AI, agents, or real-time infrastructure (not just "AI" in your LinkedIn headline)

  • You once spent a Saturday building something with an API just to see if you could 😏

 

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Competitive salary and equity package
